active.summary: AppForge Terminal real-device input/output bridge and keyboard viewport still require validation
active.evidence_required: Install the fresh post-merge APK. Open AppForge Terminal, tap the viewport and type normally. Verify typed characters/prompt/output are visible, the keyboard does not push the accessory/input row off-screen, pwd and echo APPFORGE_OK work, there is no process code 127, and logcat has no new FATAL EXCEPTION.
active.root_cause: Renderer crash and mirror argv0 were fixed. The active Termux mirror had no producer from the real AppForge PTY, so typed shell echo/output stayed in the legacy ANSI buffer and the visible Termux viewport remained blank. The terminal UI also applied the full IME inset a second time, pushing the accessory/input row outside the visible screen.
